notes.title: The Experiment: 49 - Update Notes
notes.content:
Hello The Experiment: 49 Participants,

We are back with a new update! We continue to work on making your experience more enjoyable and smooth. Here’s what we’ve done in this update:

🔧 Bug Fixes: We’ve fixed various issues in the game, so you can now enjoy a smoother experience.

🧟‍♂️ Creature Improvements: Experiment: 49 is now smarter and scarier! You’ll need to be more careful when encountering it.

🏆 New Achievements Added: We’ve added new achievements to Steam. Get ready to challenge yourself to collect them all!

🌍 Translation Updates: We’ve made adjustments to the game’s translations, so you can now better follow the story.

Thank you for all your support and feedback. The survival struggle in the world of Experiment: 49 continues!

Happy gaming!
Echo Forge Team
